data.name: 1,2,4-Trichlorobenzene with Water
measurement_methods: samples were taken from the solution for analysis by gas chromatography
The Chromatograph was equipped with a Ni^63 EC detector
mixing_methods: An excess of 1, 2, 4-trichlorobenzene was equilibrated with water in screwcapped bottles in a reciprocal shaker for 24 hours

publication_references.citation: Chiou, C.T.; Schmedding, D.W.; Manes, M., Environ. Sci. Technol. 1982, 16(1), 4-10.
